definitions.quality: Original LLM judge labels; errors count as zero complete in planned denominators; no labels have been repaired.
definitions.latency: Ask operation-log duration excludes judge. One failed generation has no ask log and is excluded from ask latency/token means.
definitions.tokens: Reported embedding-query plus generation input/output sum, excluding judge. Missing counters on failures are not imputed.
definitions.statistics: Within-book question bootstrap, 10000 replicates; question-level sign-flip permutation, 20000 replicates; Holm correction across 16 factor contrasts; seed 20261028. Conditional exploratory inference on these documents.
definitions.negative_controls: Lexical queries 3,7,8 for identical layouts 1,7,8. Prompt rendering does not contain index id.
definitions.scope: Read-only analysis. No model calls, application changes, source corpus edits, or original verdict corrections.

user_run_context: User confirmed no configuration changes, interruptions, sleep, restarts or notable parallel load during this completed run.

validation.csv_note: Quoted fields retain original model output whitespace and line breaks; no source answers normalized.
